scene_prompts.prompt: Create one original wide 16:9 painted engraving illustration for a serious dark god strategy game. This is a scene asset only, no text, no letters, no symbols that resemble writing, no UI, no borders, no logo. The scene shows an imagined civic archive of a council civilization: a tall hall of stone and tarnished bronze, plain shelves of tablets and sealed records, three clerks comparing evidence at a large table, one isolated confused adult record keeper holding a blank folio. Their society values observation and records. A single shaft of pale daylight, sober human intrigue and a subtle impossible shadow falling opposite the light, no visible god. Strong elevated three-quarter perspective and clear large silhouette groups, atmosphere of hidden machinations, copperplate etching with drybrush ink wash, fine architectural linework in selected areas, broad quiet ink shapes elsewhere. Deep graphite, faded mineral green, warm bone paper, restrained oxidised copper. Readable midtones, visible faces and hands at normal scale, sophisticated illustrated strategy game art, carefully composed, tactile printmaking rather than photoreal CGI. Two thirds architecture and group relationships, one third quiet wall. NO ocean, no island, no castle, no gothic cathedral, no tentacles, no monster, no candles everywhere, no gold-on-black, no decorative pseudo-writing. The human design and architecture are proposals rather than fixed historical culture.

Create one original wide 16:9 narrative game illustration, an illustrated dramatic scene rather than a UI mockup. No text, no lettering, no frame, no logo, no interface. An imagined council civilization's civic archive at dusk: in the foreground a confused androgynous adult record keeper, short uneven dark hair, angular tired face, plain indigo work robe and linen underlayer, ink-stained hands, carrying a blank folio against the chest. The person pauses at the threshold, turning back toward two clerks and a seated council witness deep inside the hall. A huge pale square aperture illuminates layered stone shelves, worn red plaster and bronze dividers. Their desire is to have their voice heard; the distant people are absorbed in records and do not face the protagonist. The viewer is an unseen powerful presence observing this human story, no deity shown. Hand-painted egg tempera and gouache on warm ivory, visible confident brush edges, strong ink contours used selectively, expressive faces, broad simplified shapes with precise narrative details, old storybook strategy painting but original design. Palette dusty ultramarine and indigo, warm limestone ivory, rusty cinnabar, charcoal. Luminous local contrast, rich readable middle values, not uniformly dark. Foreground left subject and middle distant group, clean room atmosphere. NO photo realism, no glossy digital concept rendering, no gothic castle, no tentacles, no ocean, no cult pentagrams, no decorative pseudo-text, no Victorian costume. Human and environment are candidate art interpretations, not historical reconstruction.

Create one original wide 16:9 woodcut scene illustration for an occult strategy game's archive case. Pure scene art with no text, no lettering, no interface, no decorative border, no logo. Imagine a council civilization that preserves anomalies in a stone archive. We see the long evidence table from the near end: several open blank folios, a simple prism-like bronze witness instrument and a circular empty seal impression; around it three small solemn clerks in plain work robes, one keeper standing apart with a blank folio. Dense vertical archive shelves in the background, a tall rectangular light well. The space reads as a working secular institution, not a temple. A subtle abnormal second cast shadow suggests a prayer entering another reality, but there is no visible god or creature. Bold linocut / relief-print artwork, sharp carved shapes, tactile cut marks, strongly designed negative space and unmistakable human silhouettes, limited flat spot-colour printing. Ivory paper, deep bottle green and near-black ink, small vermilion accents. Graphic, mature, expressive, readable, deliberately unlike a photographic render or painterly fantasy concept art. Allow broad unprinted ivory areas. NO gold, no glowing blue fog, no ocean, no castle, no cathedral, no tentacles, no occult alphabet or fake writing. This is an original cultural art proposal.
